name: spaces_delete_node
description: Deletes nodes and all their workflow connections. Deleting a panel also deletes nested children reported in expandedNodeIds. Page portals are unsupported because their linked page must be deleted in the UI. Deleting children compacts the panel and closes downstream gaps. Already-absent ids are a no-op. @see guides_get('spaces')

pageId.description: Caller-supplied ids must belong to this page; auto-expanded panel descendants may retain another page.
